placeholders.<timestamp>: Message and event timestamps (milliseconds since the epoch), and entry timestamps (ISO 8601).
placeholders.<duration-ms>: durationMs of assistant messages and tool executions.
placeholders.<entry-id>: Session entry ids pi generates (id, parentId, targetId, firstKeptEntryId).
placeholders.<tmp>: The scenario's temporary directory (cwd, agent dir, and session dir live below it).
placeholders.<session-file>: Session file name (timestamp and session id).
placeholders.<stub-url>: Base URL of the local OpenAI-compatible stub model.
placeholders.<text>: System prompt prose and tool descriptions; other fixtures cover them.
placeholders.<schema>: Tool parameter JSON schemas; local-tools.json covers them.
placeholders.<parse-error>: The JavaScript JSON.parse error text after pi's own prefix.

scenarios.name: steer
scenarios.description: A steer sent while the first reply is held is delivered after that reply, before the next model call.

scenarios.name: follow-up
scenarios.description: A follow_up sent while the first reply is held runs after the agent would otherwise stop.

scenarios.name: abort
scenarios.description: An abort while the reply is streaming, then an abort while idle.

scenarios.name: abort-with-queue
scenarios.description: An abort while a steer and a follow_up are queued: they stay queued, and the next prompt delivers them.

scenarios.name: prompt-while-busy
scenarios.description: Prompts sent during a run: without streamingBehavior (an error), then with steer and followUp, then get_state.

records.error: Agent is already processing. Specify streamingBehavior ('steer' or 'followUp') to queue the message.

scenarios.name: state
scenarios.description: get_state, get_messages, and get_last_assistant_text before and after a run, with a session dir; then set_session_name and get_state.

scenarios.name: clear-queue
scenarios.description: clear_queue during a run returns the queued steer and follow_up, which then never run.

scenarios.name: malformed-and-unknown
scenarios.description: A line that is not JSON gets a parse response; an unknown command type gets an error response; a command without an id gets a response without one.

scenarios.name: queue-modes
scenarios.description: set_steering_mode and set_follow_up_mode responses, then get_state.

scenarios.name: retry-then-success
scenarios.description: A request that fails with a retryable error (HTTP 503) is retried after a backoff and then answered.

scenarios.name: retry-exhausted
scenarios.description: Every attempt fails with a retryable error: after maxRetries retries the run ends with the last error.

scenarios.name: abort-during-retry
scenarios.description: An abort during a retry's backoff ends the run without another request.

scenarios.name: abort-retry
scenarios.description: abort_retry during a retry's backoff cancels the retry: the run ends with the failed attempt.

scenarios.name: auto-retry-off
scenarios.description: After set_auto_retry turns retries off, a retryable failure ends the run at once.

scenarios.name: no-retry
scenarios.description: A request that fails with an error that is not retryable (HTTP 401) ends the run at once.

scenarios.name: mid-stream-drop
scenarios.description: The connection drops after the reply's first delta: the partial reply is left out and the request is retried. Then get_state and get_messages.

scenarios.name: overflow-recovery
scenarios.description: The third prompt's request fails with a context overflow: pi leaves the attempt out, compacts with reason overflow (the first turn; keepRecentTokens covers the rest), and retries once.
